# rwx_directory_group_mapping (Resource)

Maps one imported directory group to an RWX group. Multiple directory groups may contribute to one target; removing or retargeting one source preserves memberships contributed by the others. Import using the local directory-group ID, not its external IdP ID.

## Setup

Connect and import the directory, review memberships, and activate directory sync in the UI. This resource does not manage activation or IdP rosters. See [directory sync](https://www.rwx.com/docs/security/directory-sync).

## Reconciliation and retries

Draft saves finish immediately. Once sync is enabled, creates, retargets, and removals wait for membership reconciliation, including when enforcement is subsequently disabled. `reconciliation_timeout` controls the wait per write and defaults to `20m`.

If a save fails or times out, run `terraform apply` again to retry the desired target. Terraform may mark a failed create as tainted and replace it on the next apply. If a destroy fails or times out, run `terraform destroy` again. The provider reports an error unless RWX confirms reconciliation succeeded; check the error before retrying if another operation changed the mapping.

## Required permissions

The provider's access token needs `org:access` and `group:manage` on all affected targets, including former targets. If the provider no longer has the target information needed to remove a mapping, removal requires unscoped `group:manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Choose either the direct-ID resource or the by-name resource for a given directory group.
resource "rwx_directory_group_mapping" "engineering" {
  directory_id       = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  directory_group_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  group_id           = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
}

data "rwx_directory" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

data "rwx_directory_group" "engineering" {
  directory_id = data.rwx_directory.engineering.id
  name         = "Engineering"
}

data "rwx_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

resource "rwx_directory_group_mapping" "by_name" {
  directory_id           = data.rwx_directory.engineering.id
  directory_group_id     = data.rwx_directory_group.engineering.id
  group_id               = data.rwx_group.engineering.id
  reconciliation_timeout = "20m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_group_id` (String) The local directory-group ID. Changing the source replaces the mapping.
- `directory_id` (String) The local directory ID. Changing the source replaces the mapping.
- `group_id` (String) The target RWX group ID. Changes retarget this source in place.

### Optional

- `reconciliation_timeout` (String) Maximum wait for membership reconciliation per write, as a positive Go duration (for example 20m or 90s). Default: 20m.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stable mapping ID (the local directory-group ID).
- `reconciliation_status` (String) The current membership reconciliation status. An incomplete or failed save is retried by the next apply.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_directory_group_mapping.engineering 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
```
